facts.statement: A community event called Pirate Party and Invasion took place in Seaside, in the cove south of the warpstone, on Friday August 18, 2009.
facts.quote: Where : Seaside, in the cove south of the warpstone

facts.statement: The event started on the beach south of the Seaside warpstone with dancing and trivia, then the crew marched on a nearby town to dance, duel and party.
facts.quote: We will dance, have trivia questions and celebrate coming ashore.

article_summaries.title: Community Event: Pirate Party and Invasion
article_summaries.summary: A community event page announcing a one-off Pirate Party and Invasion in Seaside on Friday August 18, 2009, 4pm-6pm PDT on Server 1, where players gathered on the beach south of the Seaside warpstone and marched on a nearby town. The page also promotes pirate hats for characters and pets sold for Station Cash, including an exclusive red pirate hat for a dog on 1,000 Station Cash retail cards.
